brief:
Tuesday's Florida primary elections will test voter sentiment on Islamophobia, anti-Semitism, Trump's political influence, and Israel's war on Gaza, according to Al Jazeera English. The issues have become central to campaigns across the state as candidates position themselves on Middle East policy and religious tolerance ahead of the general election.

The primary races reflect deepening divisions within both major parties over how to address the Gaza conflict and domestic concerns about discrimination. Election results may signal which issues resonate most with Florida voters heading into the final stretch of the 2024 cycle.
dek: Islamophobia, anti-Semitism, Trump's politics and Israel's war on Gaza figure prominently in the elections.
title: Florida primary elections center on Gaza, Trump, religious bias
